title: sprint-14-applied-ml-standup-research-log
content:
Sprint 14 — Applied ML weekly research standup log
Owner: Maya Chen | team: eng-applied-ml
Dates covered: 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-09
Status: in_review (working notes; will push cleaned summary to Confluence)

Purpose: capture day-to-day research progress across quantization experiments, evaluation runs, and the staged model onboarding checklist. This is intentionally informal — contains live run ids, partial results, and TODOs.

---

Friday 2026-04-09 — Weekly wrap / research sync (30m)
Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Lina, Evan (remote)

Highlights:
- Int4 calibration experiments (checkpoint: resnet-llm-7b-v2-int4) finished on small validation set. See summary below.
- Eval harness (suite: small-internal-openqa) now runs end-to-end across quantized variants; failing case rate reduced to 12% (from 18%).
- Model onboarding checklist draft ready for initial hosted-catalog submission (staged entries for int4/int8 variants).

Decisions made:
- Proceed with "flow-2" calibration procedure for int4 (per-token MSE + bias-correction). Rationale: better alignment on tail tokens for completion tasks.
- Keep int8 as fallback in the hosted catalog for latency-sensitive tiers. Rolling configuration: prefer int4 for cost tier "dev" and int8 for "prod" until we finish larger evals.

Action items:
- Arjun: run full BLEU/ROUGE/MRR sweep for resnet-llm-7b-v2 (quant: int4,int8,fp16) across 5k eval prompts by 2026-04-14. Linked: ENG-1427.
- Lina: add rollout gating rule to catalog metadata: require no regression >2% in MRR and tail-latency < 120ms on our 90th percentile. (Due 2026-04-12)
- Evan: integrate streaming stability check into eval harness (PR #2384 review). Finish by EOD 2026-04-11.
- Maya: compile short one-pager for product (hosted-api PM) summarizing current int4 tradeoffs. (Draft by 2026-04-12)

---

Notes from the week (by day)

Monday 2026-04-06 — Standup
- Quick sync on calibration scripts: moved calibration from single-pass to two-pass (rough pass + bias-correct). Reduced avg perplexity on dev set by ~6% for int4.
- Experiment: group-kv-cache disabled for int4 test to ensure we isolate KV-cache interplay. Observed throughput drop ~8% but small improvement in answer consistency.
- TODO: log randomness seeds and batch-size mapping in experiment metadata.

Tuesday 2026-04-07 — Ad-hoc deep-dive
- Ran targeted failure-case analysis for openQA-beam tests: misalignment in long-context (>1024) completions showed hallucination patterns for int4; hypothesis: quantization noise accumulates in attention scores when sequence length > 1.5k tokens.
- Experiment plan: test hybrid scheme where keys/values are kept in fp16 and activations quantized (int4). Create micro-benchmark.
- Note: this has memory implications — estimated +12% GPU memory per request for 7b models.

Wednesday 2026-04-08 — Eval day
- Batch-run: small-internal-openqa (n=1,200) finished overnight. Key metrics (preliminary):
  - Baseline fp16 (resnet-llm-7b-v2): MRR=0.682, ExactMatch=0.43, avg latency (90p) = 95ms
  - int8: MRR=0.672, ExactMatch=0.42, 90p = 83ms
  - int4 (flow-2 calibration): MRR=0.655, ExactMatch=0.39, 90p = 67ms
  - Delta (int4 vs fp16): -4.1% MRR, -4.7 pp ExactMatch, latency -29%

- Observations: int4 still acceptable for many generation tasks but underperforms on fine-grained extraction metrics. For reranking tasks int4 is close enough (MRR delta < 3%).
- Outlier cases: when prompts have long table-contexts, int4 produced truncated tokens in ~0.7% runs (root-cause likely quantization + softmax precision).

---

Experiment metadata / reproducibility logs
- Primary experiment id: AMR-S14-0423 (use in run logs)
- Runtime: inference-runtime: branch quant/flow-2-calib @ 2026-04-07 commit 9c2a4f1 (PR 2384)
- Hardware: p4d.24xlarge (reserved pool) + dev gpus (a10x8) for parallel runs
- Config snapshot (human-readable):
  - model: resnet-llm-7b-v2
  - batch_size: 8 (eval harness default)
  - seq_len: variable (mean 520, max tested 2048)
  - kv_cache: enabled (except one isolating run)
  - quant: int4 (flow-2), int8 (default), fp16 (baseline)
  - calibration dataset: internal-calib-v3 (1.1k examples, mix of code, openQA, summarization)

Quick experiment run notes:
- Run AMR-S14-0423-int4-001: seed 42, observed softmax underflow on layer 9 in 3 runs -> added explicit per-layer scale floor (temp fix)
- Run AMR-S14-0423-hybrid-001: ks/kv fp16 + activations int4 — memory +10%, 90p latency +5% vs pure int4, MRR improved +1.8% vs int4 baseline. Promising for long-context.

---

Model onboarding checklist (staged)
- Basic items (done): model artifact location (S3), SHA256 sums, model card draft, license check, initial perf snapshot
- Testing items (in progress): full eval suite run (Arjun), stability / streaming check (Evan), rollout policy (Lina)
- Security/compliance: ensure keys in KMS (private deployments) are validated — ops ticket created (OP-593).
- Catalog metadata: add fields for recommended quant profile, memory footprint, allowed rollout tiers, fallback model id. Lina to propose schema changes by 2026-04-12.

---

Open questions / Risks
- Long-context failure modes for int4: do we hold keys/values in fp16 by default for sequences > 1024? Cost impact needs analysis (cost per token + memory).
- Does the calibration procedure generalize across architectures? So far we tested only on resnet-llm family. Need 13b spot-checks.
- User-visible quality thresholds: what is acceptable MRR drop for experimental tiers? Product input needed.

Notes to self (Maya):
- Clean up AMR-S14 run metadata and push to s3://redwood-experiments/s14/ by Monday morning.
- Re-run the hybrid-001 on 13b sample to see how hybrid approach scales.

References and quick links:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/2384 (streaming + quant fixes)
- Eval issue: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ML-88/eval-suite-coverage
- Jira: ENG-1427 (int4 full sweep)
- Ops ticket: OP-593 (KMS validation)

Appendix — quick numeric summary (prelim)
- Throughput (tokens/s, batch 8, mean seq 520): fp16=4200, int8=4800 (+14%), int4=6200 (+48%)
- GPU mem (7b load): fp16=12.1GB, int8=8.9GB, int4=6.8GB
- Cost estimate per 1M tokens (on reserved p4d): fp16=$28, int8=$19, int4=$11 (back-of-envelope)

End of log.

---

Next sync: 2026-04-13 (Mon) — focus: Arjun findings on full sweep + Lina rollout gating draft.
